contents.description: Provides rich language support untuk CSS, LESS dan SCSS berkas.
contents.css.title: CSS
contents.css.customData.desc:
Daftar relative berkas paths pointing to JSON berkas following the [custom data format](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-css-languageservice/blob/master/docs/customData.md).

VS Code loads custom data on startup to enhance its CSS support untuk CSS custom properties (variables), at-rules, pseudo-classes, dan pseudo-elements you specify in the JSON berkas.

The berkas paths are relative to ruang kerja dan only ruang kerja folder pengaturan are considered.
contents.css.completion.triggerPropertyValueCompl: secara bawaan, VS Code triggers property value completion after memilih a CSS property. Use this pengaturan to nonaktifkan this behavior.
contents.css.completion.completePropertyWithSemic: Insert semicolon at end of line when completing CSS properties.
contents.css.lint.boxModel.desc: Do not use `width` atau `height` when using `padding` atau `border`.
contents.css.lint.compatibleVendorPrefixes.desc: Saat using a vendor-specific prefix make sure to also include all other vendor-specific properties.
contents.css.lint.duplicateProperties.desc: Do not use duplikasikan style definitions.
contents.css.lint.float.desc: Avoid using `float`. Floats lead to fragile CSS that is easy to break if one aspect of the layout changes.
contents.css.lint.hexColorLength.desc: Hex colors must consist of 3, 4, 6 atau 8 hex numbers.
contents.css.lint.idSelector.desc: Selectors should not contain IDs because these rules are too tightly coupled dengan the HTML.
contents.css.lint.ieHack.desc: IE hacks are only necessary when supporting IE7 dan older.
contents.css.lint.important.desc: Avoid using `!important`. It is an indication that the specificity of the entire CSS has gotten out of control dan needs to be refactored.
contents.css.lint.importStatement.desc: Import statements do not load in parallel.
contents.css.lint.propertyIgnoredDueToDisplay.des: Property is ignored due to the display. E.g. dengan `display: inline`, the `width`, `height`, `margin-top`, `margin-bottom`, dan `float` properties have no effect.
contents.css.lint.universalSelector.desc: The universal selector (`*`) is known to be slow.
contents.css.lint.validProperties.desc: Daftar properties that are not validated against the `unknownProperties` rule.
contents.css.lint.vendorPrefix.desc: Saat using a vendor-specific prefix, also include the standard property.
contents.css.trace.server.desc: Traces the communication between VS Code dan the CSS language server.
contents.css.validate.title: Mengontrol CSS validation dan problem severities.
contents.css.hover.documentation: tampilkan property dan value documentation in CSS hovers.
contents.css.hover.references: tampilkan references to MDN in CSS hovers.
contents.css.format.newlineBetweenSelectors.desc: Separate selectors dengan a new line.
contents.css.format.newlineBetweenRules.desc: Separate rulesets oleh a blank line.
Ensure a space character around selector separators `>`, `+`, `~` (e.g. `a > b`).
contents.css.format.braceStyle.desc: Put braces on the same line as rules (`collapse`) atau put braces on own line (`expand`).
contents.css.format.preserveNewLines.desc: Apakah existing line breaks before rules dan declarations should be preserved.
contents.css.format.maxPreserveNewLines.desc: Maximum number of line breaks to be preserved in one chunk, when `#css.format.preserveNewLines#` is diaktifkan.
